item.title: Log #4: July 16-19
item.description:
Second half of the second week (and the weekend)!

Thursday

Our field trip to Cal Academy in San Francisco was straight out of a movie. Our first stop was the Planetarium, where we watched a mindblowing 360 degree screen video about meteors. We then explored the indoor rainforest dome, where exotic plants bloomed and butterflies flitted about.

Friday

TF Chen led us through a series of case studies of various datasets, where we conducted exploratory dataset analysis. TA Wonjun also taught us about the math behind Principal Component Analysis, a method used to reduce dimensionality on datasets. We also learned about eigenvalues and eigenvectors.

item.title: Log #3: July 11-15
item.description:
First half of the second week (and the previous weekend)!

Saturday

For most of the day, everyone pursued their own activities. In the evening, we gathered with our clusters for dinner before the entire COSMOS program headed to the Rec Pool to swim, play beach volleyball, and relax by the pool.

Sunday

Today was a free day, giving everyone the chance to spend their time however they liked. Some hung out with family and friends, others played sports or explored the area, while many caught up on laundry, relaxed, or simply enjoyed a slower pace before the week ahead.

item.title: Log #2: July 9-10
item.description:
Second half of the first week!

Thursday

Day 4. Professor Ding went over some pretty advanced dimensionality reduction algorithms. We finally uploaded the two studies we did to our website.

Friday

Week 1 of COSMOS 2026 is almost over :(

Wonjun gave us our first quiz of the summer, and WE all aced it. Chen also gave us a preview of the possible datasets which we would be given for our final projects. We are hoping for the EEG dataset.

item.title: Log #1: July 5-8
item.description:
First half of the first week!

Sunday

All 22 members of Cluster 11 checked in and moved into our dorms (we’re located exclusively in Hawthorn and Live Oak). We met our TI, Phoebe, and our RA, Shafiq, for the first time!

Monday

First day of class in the lovely Physical and Data Sciences building. We had a lecture on the data science pipeline and after lunch had a lab dedicated to setting up our coding workflow. We also joined group 2 (the Optimizers) and began customizing our website! Each member wrote their own introduction, complete with images and some fun facts about ourselves.
